name: Agent Skills
description: Install agent skills globally from GitHub repositories using npx skills or gh skill. Supports multiple skill packages, installer selection, and agent targeting.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of skill packages (GitHub repos) to install globally

agents.description: Comma-separated agent names to install skills for (e.g. 'devin,claude,codex'). Default '*' = all detected agents

copy.description: Copy skill files instead of symlinking (recommended for npx/bunx transient caches)
